title: 🔥周期估值对标上轮大底
body: 市场处于深度磨底期。MVRV 为 1.19，低于历史 81% 的时间。对比上轮周期同期（2022-08）的 1.03，当前估值水平已极度接近上一轮熊市末期，意味着筹码结构已出清完毕，具备极高的长期配置价值。偏多。黎明前的黑暗还有多长？
title_en: 🔥 Cycle Valuation Matching the Last Macro Bottom
body_en: We are deep in the bottoming grind. MVRV sits at 1.19, lower than 81% of historical data. Compared to 1.03 in the last cycle (Aug 2022), current valuations are dangerously close to the final stages of the previous bear market. This implies the supply structure has been fully flushed, offering massive long-term value. Bullish bias. How much longer is the darkness before dawn?
